description:
Creates a certified notification request. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId. Generate a UUID v4 for `id`. Set language to en_GB or es_ES. Returns notificationRequestId. Add at least one receiver with notification_receiver_add before sending. IMPORTANT: The `content` field must be valid HTML — plain text without HTML tags will not render on the recipient landing page. Only the following HTML formats are supported: paragraphs (

), bold (), italic (), unordered lists (

  • ), ordered lists (
    1. ). Do not use other HTML tags or CSS. Avoid special typographic characters (em dashes, smart quotes) in `subject`; use standard ASCII equivalents (hyphen, straight quotes) instead.
name: notification_request_create
